{{Quote|I&hellip; I remember them more ''clearly'' now, Master. The time on Xoman Free when Master Quin and I had to rescue the little princess from the skyboat pirates!|[[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], to [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 36">[[Star Wars (1998) 36|''Star Wars'' (1998) 36]]</ref>}}
A '''young princess''' was kidnapped by [[skyboat]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. She was later [[Mission to Xoman III|rescued]] on [[Xoman III]] by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]].
